methodology.cache: warm after explicit warmups; no cache flush
methodology.workload: full process --breakdown --json, committed HEAD, same container and corpus
methodology.timing: perf_counter around process launch/completion, includes identical GNU time launcher overhead
methodology.rss: GNU time target-child peak RSS in KiB; avoids Python pre-exec RSS floor
methodology.cpu: GNU time target-child user/system seconds, 0.01-second precision
methodology.tail_note: p99+ conservative observed order statistics; 20 runs cannot estimate rare tails
methodology.correctness_gate: exact language names, byte totals, percentage strings and per-language file sets; timing withheld on mismatch
